title: Lightning Everywhere
body:
# LIGHTNING EVERYWHERE

With this mod, you can spawn a Lightning EVERYWHERE

Join my discord for news and other mods : https://discord.gg/7yXRx6yVVy


To get Uranium, you must craft a Diamond Smelter and put diamond into it.

![diamondsmelter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5e81b29e463e375ee54e14e6ecfdb4b5f7be0f35.png)![crafturanium](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/17e486b1f6dce17522afb728616361a1e841d025.png)

With Uranium, you can craft Uranium Block. It is useless, but it's funny

![uraniumblock](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/62b2f37109f7c02fc03a9228501d963f3ec968ce.png)

You can craft a lightning and do a right-click to spawn one

![lightning](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/07ca1386fec3c8d17898d0206f95d297da16706d.png)

With a normal lightning, you can craft a charged lightning, who is 5 times better!

![chargedlightning](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6f9cbea75ff71eba28826c92997b00ce1e252311.png)

This mod have been created with MCreator
